mechanism.base: Metal answers metal, the old texts say: strike one blade and the one beside it rings at the same pitch. Steel is sharpened on steel, two edges ground together taking a finer line than either could reach alone. Nothing yields in that meeting. Iron piled on iron grows heavier, and an edge with no softer thing before it has nothing left to cut except its own kind.
mechanism.catalyst_turn: With too little Metal, the edge has no weight behind it and every cut costs more than it takes. The line goes thin in the middle. Sleep before you decide anything.
mechanism.friction_turn: With too much Metal, the blade grinds on itself with nothing to cut and every argument becomes a test of who holds the harder line. Hand the edge one real job this week.

catalyst.clause: The edge has no weight behind it and every cut costs more than it takes.

friction.clause: The blade grinds on itself with nothing to cut.
friction.remedy: Hand the edge one real job this week.

unrooted.clause: No Metal under the core: a point with no steel behind it, held by whatever is nearest.
unrooted.remedy: Start with the base: sleep, food, one rule kept every day.

excess.clause: Metal this heavy needs water to take the point off, or the edge cuts everything the same.
excess.remedy: Let it flow out: one thing said, one thing shipped.

thin.clause: Metal is a small thing in you, an edge kept short and used only where it counts.
thin.remedy: Keep it that size. Spend the rest elsewhere.

function.definition_catalyst: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Metal makes it hard, and your will holds. Running thin, strength gives out, so you manage alone rather than lean on a peer and bet big instead of resting. You last longest once you let rest and company in.
function.definition_friction: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Metal keeps it exact, so your standard holds. Running over, your will sits unused, and you trust your call more than a peer's in every fight over shared stakes. Remember that you trade a peer for each argument won.
function.advise_catalyst: You treat rest as something you earn after the work instead of the thing the work runs on. Take rest in first and sleep before the hard decision rather than after it. Let one peer carry a job you could do yourself. Sit out one contest a month on purpose. Eat before you answer the message.
function.advise_friction: Seek Fire, the Order energy. Fire is heat with a deadline that gives your force a direction and a judge. Let it spend what Metal stores. You stay in charge of yourself by being right. Ship one finished thing to someone above you by their date. Say your plan to a person who can refuse it.

candidates.cta_verdict: Your strength is the kind you make alone, so you measure yourself against your own last best rather than against anyone beside you.
